resources.string: Automatic status needs optional Shizuku and readable current GMS state. Otherwise confirm in Google diagnostics.
What does the Google diagnostics page show? This is a dated manual observation, not continuous monitoring.
Google push server reachable (network probe only)
Probe failed; inspect the network or VPN. This does not prove GMS is disconnected.
Google Play services: installed and enabled
Google Play services: unavailable or disabled
An established GMS socket on a standard push port was observed. This is transport evidence, not a Diagnostics verdict.
No UID-attributed standard-port socket observed; the connection may use another port or be hidden.
Requests may be ignored. Confirm the result in diagnostics. Limited to once per minute.
Choose your apps to review push components, permissions and background settings.

%1$d apps scanned · %2$d declare FCM/GCM · %3$d chosen\nAutostart in this list: %4$d enabled · %5$d disabled · %6$d partial · %7$d unknown\nApps with detected issues appear first. Tap a row for checks and settings.
Choose the apps whose notifications matter to you.
No FCM/GCM components detected; another push channel may be used
A system-policy reference that other tools can also modify. Review the complete battery policy in Settings.
Notification permission granted; the master switch and channels still need review
Notification master switch and channels: review in Settings
Android battery-optimization exemption: %1$s (separate from HyperOS policy)
The app is marked stopped. Open it once and sign in before testing.
No stopped flag detected; this does not mean the process is running
Background process status is unavailable. Check recents locking manually; FCM normally does not require a resident app process.

Open the target app, return to recents, then use HyperOS’s lock action on its task card (often by long-pressing the card). Availability varies by launcher. Locking is optional and does not guarantee delivery.
I checked the notification master switch, categories, and in-app mute / DND settings
I confirmed No restrictions in this app’s HyperOS battery settings
I confirmed the recents task is locked
I received a real test message after locking the phone
User reports, not automatic detections. App updates invalidate records. Review again after changing settings.
Refresh on system-list and network changes
No persistent notification or scheduled wakeups. Checks pause when the process cannot run; use the tile to resume.
Off by default. Reads current GMS connection state for the dashboard and tile without changing settings.
The system setting is absent or cannot be read
The system returned an empty list
This settings or diagnostics page is unavailable on this device
Attempting a heartbeat request and network check. Verify the result in diagnostics.
Start Shizuku first, or leave the optional feature off
Send a message to the chosen app from another account/device. Test while unlocked, then after locking for 10–30 minutes. Record only what you actually received.

Lit with Connected means GMS was just observed connected. A grey disconnected icon with Disconnected means GMS was just observed disconnected. A question mark with Unknown means unreadable, not off. Enable optional Shizuku. Refreshes every 5 seconds while visible, with no polling when hidden. Tap to try a heartbeat and open diagnostics; this does not turn off GMS push.
Automatic refresh is partly unavailable. Return to this page or use Refresh to check again.
Authorized, but the system restricts reading connection information. FCM status cannot be confirmed.
This system does not support the connection query command.
The connection information format is not supported on this system.
The system hides connection ownership; GMS connections cannot be identified.
Connection information timed out. Try checking again.
The helper is connected, but this query failed. Try checking again.
Authorized, but the system did not provide usable connection information.
Source: current GMS service state · %1$s. Refreshed only while the dashboard or quick-settings panel is visible, not continuous monitoring.
No readable GMS push service. Open Google diagnostics and retry; this does not prove disconnection.
The previous connection result expired. Waiting for a fresh read.
